presets.name: Ancient explainer (Ink style)
presets.visual_style: Hand-drawn ink pen sketch, slightly wobbly black lines, flat muted watercolor fills (sand beige, ochre, teal sky, campfire orange). Cute minimalist characters: big round head, dot eyes, simple stick limbs. About 30% of shots are white-background concept cards with one doodle object and handwritten all-caps text; red X-outs for 'not this'.
presets.image_prompt_template: Hand-drawn ink sketch illustration, wobbly black pen lines, flat muted watercolor fill, simple cute stick-figure cartoon style, 16:9. Scene: {scene_description}. Characters: {character_refs}. Setting: {setting}, {time_of_day}. Mood: {mood}. {optional_text_label: 'handwritten all-caps label reading "{label}"'}. Clean composition, lots of negative space, YouTube explainer style.
presets.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, anime, manga, detailed realistic faces, gradients, glossy, lens flare, watermark, logo, extra limbs, deformed hands, garbled text, misspelled text, cluttered background

character_bible_template.name: {name}
character_bible_template.look: round oversized head, two dot eyes, small expressive mouth, {hair} hair, stick arms and legs
character_bible_template.outfit: {outfit, e.g. brown fur tunic with jagged hem}
character_bible_template.contrast_character: modern 'you': bald white stick figure, plain office clothes

camera_motion_rules: Ken Burns on every still: zoom 1.00->1.08 or slow lateral pan over shot length
white concept cards: tiny zoom or static
presets.subtitle_style: Optional; if used: bold rounded sans, white with black outline, 1-3 words per line pop-in, lower third. On-image key words handled by handwritten labels.
presets.music_mood: soft lo-fi / acoustic ambient, low (-28 dB under voice); SFX: whoosh on text cards, fire crackle, record-scratch on twists
script_structure_template: HOOK (0-30s): modern 'you' pain point -> 'Now rewind {N} years' -> ancient person's contrast
MYTH (30-60s): 'Your brain is already fighting this...' official story vs buried proof
QUESTION: title question + 'to answer that we have to start in the ground'
EVIDENCE x3-5 chapters, each with a twist ('But it's the opposite')
PAYOFF: what we lost; loop back to modern alarm clock
CTA: soft subscribe tied to next question
hook_formulas: This morning, {modern annoyance} happened to you. Now rewind {N} years.
Your brain is already fighting this. {common belief}. That was the official story. But the proof it's wrong was {where}.
So how does a man with {none of X} end up with more {Y} than you?
title_formulas: What Did Ancient Humans Actually Do {time_period}?
When Did Ancient Humans Start {modern habit}?
The Disturbing Ways Ancient Humans {did X}
Why Are We the Only {thing} Left?

example_scene_prompts.line: This morning, a machine screamed at you until you woke up.
example_scene_prompts.prompt: Hand-drawn ink sketch, wobbly lines, white background: a red analog alarm clock shaking violently with jagged scream lines, bald stick figure in bed covering ears, 16:9

example_scene_prompts.line: He owns a spear, two animal hides, and a fire.
example_scene_prompts.prompt: Hand-drawn ink sketch, flat watercolor: caveman with messy brown hair, round head, dot eyes, brown fur tunic, sitting up stretching beside a small campfire, wooden spear and two hides on the ground, golden morning light over sandy plain, 16:9

example_scene_prompts.line: The strong skeleton belonged to the hunter-gatherer. The wrecked one belonged to the farmer.
example_scene_prompts.prompt: Hand-drawn ink sketch, white background: two skeletons side by side, left tall and sturdy labeled handwritten 'HUNTER', right short and cracked labeled 'FARMER', archaeologist stick figure with brush looking surprised, 16:9

presets.name: Ottoman Days style (history role-play)
presets.visual_style: Cute minimalist stick-figure characters (round heads, dot eyes) placed in richly painted 2D Ottoman interiors and cityscapes: Iznik blue tiles, latticed windows, carpets, domes and minarets, Bosphorus at sunset. Palette teal, terracotta, gold, crimson, cream. Costume encodes rank. Interleaved white caption cards (dark all-caps text), boxed name tags, portrait medallions with role labels, simple bar charts and family trees.
presets.image_prompt_template: 2D digital storybook illustration, soft painterly backgrounds, simple cute cartoon characters with round heads and dot eyes, 16:9. Setting: {ottoman_location} ({year}), Iznik tiles, latticed windows, warm {lighting}. Scene: {scene_description}. Characters: {character_refs} wearing {costume}. {optional_label: 'small boxed name tag reading "{name}"'}. Historical explainer style.
presets.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D, anime, realistic faces, modern clothing, European castle, Arabic gibberish text, garbled letters, watermark, gore, extra limbs, oversaturated neon

character_bible_template.name: {name}
character_bible_template.look: round head, dot eyes, {skin tone}, {facial hair}
character_bible_template.headwear: {tall white kavuk turban | jeweled crown with veil | red fez}

camera_motion_rules: Ken Burns on all painted scenes, slow pans across wide palace rooms
caption/text cards static or 3% zoom with whoosh
zoom into name tag or medallion when a person is introduced
hard cuts; 'X YEARS LATER' card for time skips
presets.subtitle_style: Text cards carry key facts; optional captions in serif cream text with dark shadow, bottom center.
presets.music_mood: gentle Middle-Eastern / Ottoman-inspired ambient (oud, ney, soft percussion), low under voice; occasional drum hit on reveals
script_structure_template: HOOK: modern relatable scene -> 'Now imagine' Ottoman version with twist -> hard date + number
TITLE QUESTION: 'So why did it suck to be {role}?' + secondary question
PREMISE: 'You're going to live her life from the very first day. You're built from several real people; every rule is real.'
LIFE STAGES: birth -> childhood -> marriage/office -> crisis -> death/legacy, each with named real figures and a number
ENDING: verdict on whether it sucked + tease next role
hook_formulas: You're at {modern event}. {What normally happens}. Now imagine {Ottoman version} where {shocking difference}.
In {year}, the palace in Istanbul {did X} and spent {number}.
So why did it suck to be {role}? And why were {others} more afraid of {event} than she was?
title_formulas: Why It Sucked to Be the {Role} (in the Ottoman Empire)
What Did the {Role} Actually Do All Day?
What Actually Happened When You Became the {Role}?
What Did Ottomans Do for {Activity}? (It Was Actually {Adjective})

example_scene_prompts.prompt: White background caption card, bold dark all-caps text '50,000+ GOLD COINS' with a small stack of gold coins doodle, 16:9

example_scene_prompts.prompt: 2D storybook illustration: Topkapi palace room with blue Iznik tiles and lattice window, cute round-headed Sultan Suleiman in tall white turban and gold kaftan holding a swaddled baby, small boxed name tag 'SULTAN SULEIMAN', soft gold light, 16:9

presets.name: Science explainer (Joe style)
presets.visual_style: Clean flat 2D digital illustration, crisp black outlines, soft cel shading, warm earthy palette with bright skies. Mix of white-background stick-figure concept shots and fully painted landscapes; heavy infographic use: labeled comparisons, maps with migration arrows, family trees, DNA, lineups.
presets.image_prompt_template: Clean flat 2D vector-style illustration, crisp black outlines, soft cel shading, friendly cartoon characters, {background: 'plain white background' | 'painted {environment}'}, 16:9. Scene: {scene_description}. Characters: {character_refs}. Infographic elements: {labels_or_arrows_or_map}. Educational YouTube explainer.
presets.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D, anime, horror, gore, garbled text, misspelled labels, watermark, cluttered, dark moody lighting, extra limbs

character_bible_template.name: {name}
character_bible_template.look: simple cartoon human, oval head, dot eyes, {skin tone}, {hair}
character_bible_template.narrator_avatar: white stick figure with round head used for 'you'/concept shots

camera_motion_rules: slow Ken Burns (zoom 1.00->1.05) on every still
pan along maps following migration arrows
split-screen for A vs B comparisons
hard cuts; occasional quick cut to text card for chapter titles
presets.subtitle_style: Chapter title cards in black all-caps hand lettering on white; optional clean sans captions.
presets.music_mood: calm curious ambient / light piano and pads, quiet (voice at about -19 dB mean)
script_structure_template: HOOK: 'It's roughly {N} years ago. You're {who}...' -> surprising claim -> big question
3-5 named chapters (spoken headers like 'The Asian shortcut'), each: mechanism -> evidence -> analogy
Wrap-up: what it means for us today
hook_formulas: It's roughly {N} years ago. You're a {thing}, not a {a}, not a {b}, just a {plain}.
If you could {impossible observation}, one thing would immediately jump out: {surprise}.
Which raises a surprisingly interesting question: {title question}
